# Ismat Duckson Aziz

> Ismat Duckson Aziz is a Fortune 500 CHRO, board director, and McKinsey senior advisor who helps boards and executive teams lead through transformation.

## Ways to work with her
- **Enterprise & transformation advisory** — Advisor and Executive Coach to Boards, CEOs and Executives on elevating the human capital agenda to drive transformational results. Expert partner in AI acceleration and technological adaptation across multiple industries and sectors.
- **Board Readiness** — Coaching and Advisory services for executives aspiring to board seats. Expertise in board governance, compensation committee and strategy. Ismat is a Chartered Director (C. Dir) through McMaster's Directors College.
- **Keynotes & Speaking Engagements** — Frequent Speaker on topics related to human capital, AI acceleration, driving transformational large scale change and change acceleration. 
- **Executive Coaching** — Executive coach to Board Directors, CEO’s, CHRO’s and Executives across multiple industries and sectors.

## Areas of expertise
Human capital strategy, Chief Human Resources Officer leadership, Corporate governance, Organizational transformation, AI adoption in the workforce, Executive compensation, ESG and corporate social responsibility, Mergers and acquisitions integration

## Recognition
- Reuters Events Trailblazing Women in Insurance (2024)
